notes.title: It's time to navigate the neon dream in Sex City: 2069!🌆
notes.content:
The game is now out, so no time for hesitation left! Grab your favourite weapon as the stunning half-cyborg Nix explores a futuristic city, with your help and guidance, of course. 

Fight your way through all the enemies trying to stop you from completing the goal of finding out what all the mysterious conspiracy is about. In the future, technology merges reality with fiction, allowing you to experience things in a completely new way - you have the power to immensely change everything about yourself and the world around you if you manage to successfully combine strategy, skills and mindset on your way to getting over the intense missions that often lead to as much intense and hot explicit encounters - get ready 🔥. 

There's also a little something that might help some of you explore the game - a few free keys! If you've managed to get one in time - congratulations on being fast and attentive enough!

notes.title: Time to roam the city has almost come! ⌚
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We had to delay the release to polish the game and make it much more ready to be released - development can be a tangled process sometimes, and we found out that some things should be fixed right before the release. Better late than never - required changes will vastly enhance the player's experience! 

[h3]The game will be released on July 20, so get ready to take your weapon and put the city under your shoe![/h3]

Feel free to ask any questions about our upcoming shooter and share your thoughts. Let us know if any of you would like to participate in a quiz similar to those we had before Sex of Thrones came out - great chance to win free keys and just to have fun with other AVN enjoyers! If enough people show their interest, we'll host a quiz for sure.

[h3]We'll see you guys soon![/h3] 🌆

notes.title: The sun sets over the Sex City: 2069, so let the lights ignite! 🌠
notes.content:
The city bleeds chrome as you try to find your way through the wicked conspiracy around - this Saturday will let you explore a vibrant, colorful and technologic yet dangerous world. The Sex City: 2069 offers a diverse range of weapons to master, enemies to conquer, missions to complete, characters to meet and get to know, and, of course, adult scenes to play around! We decided to experiment with the gameplay and game flow, so it's definitely worth checking out if you enjoy a potent mix of cyberpunky aesthetics, 
intense action, and lewd content! If you're really interested - make sure to hop on the release one of the first - we have prepared an intriguing bonus for some of you!😉

notes.title: Neon skies ignite! Sex City: 2069 is coming out soon. 🤖
notes.content:
We’re almost there gamers - although it’s only 2024, our game is actually coming out in a few months! The exact date can’t be revealed yet, but we’ll give you a slight hint - it’s the end of May.
We took notice of all the complaints regarding the demo version, and currently we’re working on improving the game, and polishing every bit we can, so you’ll enjoy it at its best. ⚒
Get prepared for intense adult scenes and just as intense shooter gameplay with a variety of guns and enemies - just a little bit more time and the game is out!

Thanks for staying with us and helping with testing the demo, our team is glad to have you guys! 💕

notes.title: Short description of the "SEX CITY: 2069"
notes.content:
Sex City: 2069 is a third-person cyberpunk shooter where you embody an enchanting main heroine in a cyberpunk and scientific fiction atmosphere. 

It's not just a game; it's a atmospheric dive into the future. Throughout the game, you'll experience a captivating story with various plotlines. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359576/c028ef1e08b62297906b860b4dbf29be1c40fdf1.jpg[/img]
Unlike many games, it features real-time adult content rather than rendered adult videos, giving you the ability to influence the adult scenes. In the future, additional indicators will be added, making the adult content more flexible in its settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359576/b9e9c72c1608710f555b35415a689f0c880fbf57.png[/img]
Encounter a clever enemy AI capable of selecting weapons, ammunition, and throwing grenades. The game also boasts cool soundtracks for both combat and city traversal.
